commands.name: project-init
commands.description: Scaffold a production/ workspace: project.yaml, directory layout, and phase plan.

commands.name: source-analyze
commands.description: Break source prose or a script into events, entities, and a fact registry with open questions.

commands.name: story-bible
commands.description: Compile the canon: facts by provenance, world rules, timeline, and character arcs.

commands.name: series-plan
commands.description: Divide the story into issues with source spans, page budgets, and status.

commands.name: character-bible
commands.description: Define identity, distinguishing features, wardrobe states, and reference-sheet plans for every character.

commands.name: location-bible
commands.description: Define locations with levels, landmarks, exits, and lighting logic.

commands.name: prop-bible
commands.description: Catalog plot-relevant props with appearance, state timeline, and custody tracking.

commands.name: style-bible
commands.description: Lock the visual language: line, tone, color mode, lettering style, and the frozen style block.

commands.name: visual-development
commands.description: Generate and iterate the master references: character sheets, location plates, and look pages.

commands.name: ingest-references
commands.description: Analyze user-supplied reference material and fold it into the bibles and the reference registry with provenance.

commands.name: issue-breakdown
commands.description: Break one issue into scenes and beats with cast, geography, and a page budget per beat.

commands.name: page-plan
commands.description: Plan every page of an issue: panel count, grid, panel sizes, reading order, and page turns.

commands.name: panel-script
commands.description: Write the full panel script for planned pages: framing, cast, action, acting, and exact lettering text.

commands.name: thumbnails
commands.description: Rough each page as thumbnails and check readability before final generation.

commands.name: panel-ledger
commands.description: Fill and audit the per-panel ledger of position, custody, wardrobe, and physical state.

commands.name: smart-page
commands.description: Turn one scene into finished page plans: layout, panel script, ledger, reference plan, and prompts.

commands.name: reference-plan
commands.description: Decide which approved reference images each page conditions on, one role per image.

commands.name: generate-pages
commands.description: Generate pages one at a time through image providers, with cost confirmation and provenance.

commands.name: visual-review
commands.description: Review rendered pages against plan and references; record findings, gates, and a verdict.

commands.name: repair-page
commands.description: Repair a flagged page as a sibling version, then recheck the whole page and its neighbors.

commands.name: lettering
commands.description: Plan, place, and check balloons, captions, and sound effects for in-image or overlay lettering.

commands.name: cover
commands.description: Plan the cover of an issue, generate and review it, and record the approved render.

commands.name: continuity-review
commands.description: Audit continuity across pages and issue boundaries and write the end-of-issue state.

commands.name: build-edition
commands.description: Assemble reviewed pages into an edition and export PDF, CBZ, web reader, images, and EPUB.

commands.name: full-production
commands.description: Orchestrate the whole pipeline from source text to published edition, with approval gates and cost confirmation.

commands.name: humanize
commands.description: Rewrite generated or existing prose so it reads human, or audit it with --check.

commands.name: self-review
commands.description: Run the self-evaluation pass on existing artifacts and report or fix what it finds.
